newsitem.title: POLAND: LG SUBSIDIARY TO LEND BWR PLN 10 MLN.
newsitem.headline: LG SUBSIDIARY TO LEND BWR PLN 10 MLN.

text.p: LG Investment Holding BV, a subsidiary of South Korea's LG Group, will lend Poland's Bank Wspolpracy Regionalnej (BWR) 10 million zlotys on February 7 next year, BWR said in a statement on Tuesday.
It said the seven-year loan would be partly or entirely exchangeable for common shares offered in possible future BWR issues.
BWR management board member Piotr Bak told Reuters that the money would go toward expanding the bank's operations.
He would not give any further details.
The statement said the loan has been set for three months after November 7, the day LG Investment Holding takes up a majority stake in Polish bank Petrobank .
